{{Top}}
{{Quote|A moment. That beast there, do you see it? The Force flows even through these simple creatures. If you empty your mind, you may be able to feel its thoughts. ''[&hellip;]'' Basic instincts, primal urges, every breath dominated by the needs of the moment. The Force is strong in such creatures, but their minds are weak, prey for those able to hear their thoughts and influence them.|[[Kreia]] teaches the [[Meetra Surik|exile]] the relationship between sentience, the lack thereof, and the Force|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Species-AoR.png|thumb|right|450px|Various sentient species (and a droid)]]
'''Sentience''' was the ability of a [[Species/Legends|species]] to think intelligently. It was commonly determined by the being's ability to reason, speak, and manipulate tools. Creatures that completely lacked that ability were classified as '''non-sentient''', while those that appeared to have emerging sentience were classified as '''semi-sentient'''. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]], despite not being technically alive to begin with, were regarded as sentients.

==Definition==
According to ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', ghostwritten by [[Ann Margaret Lewis]] based on data collected by [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]], "a [[Species/Legends|species]] given the sentient definition is considered able to reason and understand abstract metaphorical concepts and ideas, make and use tools, and communicate with written or spoken [[Language/Legends|language]]." Species that did not reason at all and survived via their natural instincts were classified as '''non-sentient''',<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> or sometimes as '''sub-sentient'''.<ref name="Hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|life/1337_1.html|Best in Show Eaten by Second-Best}}</ref> Non-sentience did not imply the lack of any form of intelligence. Species that appeared to have emerging sentience were classified as '''semi-sentient'''. These included species that had very primitive capabilities to manipulate tools, use language, and/or solve problems.<ref name="EGAS" /> Examples included the [[Arkanian dragon/Legends|Arkanian dragon]], the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], the [[Bafforr tree]], the [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]], [[pecoppi parrot]]s, and the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]].

==History==
[[File:Alien_lineup3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A group of sentient species]]
In the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an [[Annual Mid-Rim Domesticated Sub-Sentient Show]] was held for non-sentient creatures.<ref name="Hnn" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] would often recategorize sentient species such as the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] as non-sentient, allowing it to enslave them without formally violating the laws protecting sentient beings from such abuse.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], sentience encompasses<ref name="EGAS" /> both [[Wikipedia:Sentience|sentience]] and [[Wikipedia:Wisdom#Sapience|sapience]] in the real-world.<ref name="Sentience">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/sentience|text=Sentience|archivedate=20200806030809}}</ref><ref name="Sapience">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/sapience|text=Sapience|archivedate=20200610101424}}</ref>
